pdftotext (Poppler / Xpdf utilities)
====================================

Vendored component for dsh-plugin-corpus:
- Binary: `pdftotext.exe` plus MinGW runtime DLLs (Windows x64)
- Upstream: https://poppler.freedesktop.org/ (Xpdf-derived utilities)
- License: **GNU General Public License, version 2 or later** (see `LICENSE` in
  this directory); the MinGW runtime libraries carry their own runtime
  exceptions.
- Origin of this binary: Git for Windows `mingw64/bin` copy, 2026-10-26.

Usage: local PDF text extraction only. If a text layer exists, `pdftotext`
extracts it quickly; if it is missing or empty, dsh-plugin-corpus falls back to
its pure-JS PDF reader, then to the packaged Windows OCR script.

**Redistribution:** the project is GPL-2.0-or-later and the default plugin zip
includes this binary together with `LICENSE` and `SOURCE-OFFER.txt`. If you
redistribute this build, keep those files and satisfy the GPL's source
availability requirements. A `-PublicSafe` package that excludes these binaries
is available for environments that do not want to redistribute GPL executables.
The pure-JS PDF reader and Windows OCR remain available without it.
